objectives.description: Redeploy the source store; confirm all five edited files propagated byte-identical; run the complete, unnarrowed gate set; root-cause and resolve any failures; record the acceptance-item-1 end-to-end result

approaches_tried.approach: Re-ran gate 13 in isolation and the single failing suite (test-verify-deploy-context-budget.sh) in isolation, twice each, to distinguish a transient flake from a stable, explainable condition before considering exclusion.
approaches_tried.reason: Both reproduced identically across repeat invocations with the same two session UUIDs, confirming ongoing concurrent-sibling Bash-tool activity as the stable cause, not a one-off race.

deviations.description: Run the complete gate set: timeout 3000 bash .claude/scripts/verify-deploy.sh. All gates green.
deviations.reason: 2 of 35 checks failed (gate 8's one suite, gate 13's 2 orphan findings), both traced to the same pre-existing, unrelated cause: hooks/detect-noop-bash.sh's per-session tmp/noop-bash-shapes-<uuid> runtime files, not yet in deploy-orphan-detection.md's exclusion-class table, inherited by the one failing suite's symlinked fixture. Confirmed unrelated to any of this task's 5 edited files (all other gates, including 3, 4, and 5, are fully green, proving the redeploy correctly cleared all expected drift). Closed via the five-condition COMPLETED WITH EXCLUSIONS admission test with a full Reasoned Exclusions record in the plan rather than treating as a task regression or leaving the phase PARTIAL.
